name: Staywell
source:
You wake up in a strange place and come face to face with a past self.  Where will you end up? What conversations will you have?

[From [url=https://meiri.itch.io/staywell]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在陌生的地方醒来，与过去的自己正面相遇。你最终会去往何方？你们之间又会展开怎样的对话？

[摘自[url=https://meiri.itch.io/staywell]itch.io[/url]]
